mapper.select: select * from tea_shippingaddr order by m_no desc
mapper.insert: insert into tea_shippingaddr(s_no, s_deliveryname, s_name, s_zipno, s_addr, s_phone, s_defaddr, m_no) values(tea_shippingaddr_seq.NEXTVAL, #{s_deliveryname}, #{s_name}, #{s_zipno}, #{s_addr}, #{s_phone}, #{s_defaddr}, #{m_no})
